title: a11y_scale/65000ms.png is re-blessed but absent from the PR body's cause table (6 changed PNGs, 5 documented)
evidence: git diff --name-only 0b2aeb9..HEAD -- goldens/ lists: goldens/a11y_deutan/65000ms.png, goldens/a11y_protan/65000ms.png, goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png, goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png, goldens/a11y_tritan/65000ms.png, goldens/juice/65000ms.png. The PR body table documents only: "Exactly **6 crisis-carrying T2 frames**, all the juice scene @65s with" / "| `goldens/juice/65000ms.png` | non-involved network receded (43,692 px) |" / "| `goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/65000ms.png` | same frame under each CVD mode table (43,688 px) |" / "| `goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png` | same frame, reduced-motion (43,656 px) |". grep for "a11y_scale" in _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md and spec-viscomm-crisis-duck.md returns zero matches (the spec's prediction row did name it: "predicted: juice@65s, surge@65s+149s, estate_surge@75s, a11y_×5@65s").
detail: The spec's golden discipline mandates "Cause-document every re-blessed frame"; the sixth changed golden (the ×1.50 UI-scale a11y variant) has no cause row anywhere, and the table's enumeration contradicts the "Exactly 6" count.
recommended_fix: Add the missing row to the PR body table: goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png — same juice@65s crisis frame rendered at the ×1.50 UI-scale mode.

title: Dublin frontage-edge recede rides line alpha — a no-op under the rlsw renderer the goldens run on
evidence: app/render/dublin.odin: "// the street-facing edge line (the block's frontage read)" / "	edge := fam" / "	edge.a = u8(90 * crisis_recede_scale(recede))" / "	rl.DrawLineEx({q[0].x, q[0].y}, {q[1].x, q[1].y}, 1.5 * v.scale, edge)". The codebase's own trap note (app/render/view.odin:1319-1321, draw_family_wash): "// The wash is an alpha-blended FILL (rlsw-safe — the 7.1 field note: fills / // alpha-blend in the software renderer; only LINE alpha is ignored)." The same diff handles the trap correctly in draw_tier_ring (app/render/view.odin:1756-1758): "draw_tier_ring :: proc(v: ^View, c: rl.Vector2, dst: rl.Rectangle, tier: rl.Color, recede: f32 = 0.0) {" / "	ring := crisis_recede(v, recede, tier)" / "	ring.a = 255".
detail: rlsw ignores line alpha, so the harness/goldens render this edge opaque while the GPU game fades it mid-crisis — the frontage-edge recede is unverifiable by T2 goldens and diverges game-vs-harness. Inert bytes unaffected (90×1=90).
recommended_fix: Recede the frontage edge by pre-composing its RGB toward canvas via crisis_recede (alpha untouched), mirroring draw_tier_ring's ring handling, instead of scaling alpha on a DrawLineEx.
